## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich lasse mich davon inspirieren.** — [ikh LAH-suh mikh dah-FON in-spee-REE-ren] — *I let myself be inspired by it.*
2. **Das klingt vielversprechend.** — [dahs klingt FEEL-fair-shpreh-khent] — *That sounds promising.*
3. **Ich genieße den freien Tag.** — [ikh geh-NEE-suh dehn FRY-en tahk] — *I'm enjoying the day off.*
